intended_object: A test fixture: a toy instance of the library's `FiniteSurfaceTriangulation` data structure on `PUnit`. Its docstring says it is "used only to test the data conversion API".
explanation: The docstring says this is a minimal example built only to exercise the library's data conversion API. It is not meant to model any mathematical object. In fact it is not a real triangulation of anything: it takes one triangle with three edges, sets the realization space to `PUnit` and uses the identity homeomorphism. A one-point space is not a triangle, so no topological triangulation is being described. The structure's fields apparently do not tie `realization` to the combinatorial data, which is why this inhabitant type-checks. Since it is a test device with no counterpart in the literature, the right verdict is not_a_mathematical_object.
